dialogues.jp: 美春は悩んでいた。
dialogues.en: "But everything isn't always so dramatic, you know?"
dialogues.text: "But everything isn't always so dramatic, you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「思い出なんて、そこかしらに転がってるもの
　だと思ったんですけどねぇ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not looking for anything dramatic. Even something
trivial. Anything people can use to relate to me as 'Miharu
Amakase-san'."
dialogues.text:
"I'm not looking for anything dramatic. Even something
trivial. Anything people can use to relate to me as 'Miharu
Amakase-san'."

dialogues.jp: 椅子にぐでっと腰かけて、大きなため息を吐く。
dialogues.en:
Honestly, I couldn't care less. But I'm not gonna tell her
about how I feel because she is so serious.
dialogues.text:
Honestly, I couldn't care less. But I'm not gonna tell her
about how I feel because she is so serious.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「たとえば、美術室でも、英語教室でも色んな
　ことがあったと思うんですよ」
dialogues.en: And I know how serious she is.
dialogues.text: And I know how serious she is.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、そんなに劇的な出来事って、日常生活
　にそうはないと思うぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"I attended a committee meeting, but nothing came to mind.
I'm sure I went through a lot of stuff at school."
dialogues.text:
"I attended a committee meeting, but nothing came to mind.
I'm sure I went through a lot of stuff at school."

dialogues.jp:
正直なところ、俺としては、どっちでもいいん
じゃないかなーとも思うんだけど、美春の健気
な姿を見ているとそうも言えない。
dialogues.en: "What makes you think that?"
dialogues.text: "What makes you think that?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「風紀委員の話し合いに参加しても、何にも思
　い出せないんですよ。結構波瀾万丈だった気
　がするんですけど」
dialogues.en:
"Well, through the work I did today, which turned out to be
pretty chaotic. In fact, I gave Nemu-sempai some trouble."
dialogues.text:
"Well, through the work I did today, which turned out to be
pretty chaotic. In fact, I gave Nemu-sempai some trouble."

dialogues.jp:
美春がまた大きなため息をつく。何か嫌なこと
でも思い出したらしい。
dialogues.en: Miharu sighs deeply in disappointment.
dialogues.text: Miharu sighs deeply in disappointment.

dialogues.jp: がっくりと頭を下げたまま、動かなくなる。
dialogues.en: Then she drops her head.
dialogues.text: Then she drops her head.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、気にすることはないだろうよ。どうせ、
　｛・・・・・・／いつものこと｝なんだろうし」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about it. It's one of those days, right?"
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about it. It's one of those days, right?"

dialogues.jp:
相当ショックなことがあったのか、美春は頭を
下げたままだ。逆にそれがなんだか面白い。
dialogues.en:
Miharu must be totally disappointed. She still keeps her
head down.
dialogues.text:
Miharu must be totally disappointed. She still keeps her
head down.

dialogues.jp:
「本物の美春が元気だったときだって、ずいぶ
　ん音夢が愚痴をこぼしてたぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Nemu was complaining about the real Miharu too when she was
at school."
dialogues.text:
"Nemu was complaining about the real Miharu too when she was
at school."

dialogues.jp: はははと笑うが、美春は反応してくれない。
dialogues.en: I laughed, but there is no reaction from Miharu.
dialogues.text: I laughed, but there is no reaction from Miharu.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、美春〜。なんとか言えよう」
dialogues.en: "Hey Miharu! Say something."
dialogues.text: "Hey Miharu! Say something."

dialogues.jp: こういうとき、相手がノッてこないと寂しい。
dialogues.en: Is she ignoring me?
dialogues.text: Is she ignoring me?

dialogues.jp: 「美春？」
dialogues.en: "Miharu?"
dialogues.text: "Miharu?"

dialogues.jp:
いい加減、返事をしないってのはどういうこと
だろうか。
dialogues.en: What's going on?
dialogues.text: What's going on?

dialogues.jp: 俺は席を立ち、美春の肩をポンと叩く。
dialogues.en: I stand up and pat Miharu's shoulder.
dialogues.text: I stand up and pat Miharu's shoulder.

dialogues.jp: 美春の身体がぐらりと崩れ、横に倒れた。
dialogues.en: Miharu's body falls down.
dialogues.text: Miharu's body falls down.

dialogues.jp: 「えっ、おわぁ」
dialogues.en: "What?!"
dialogues.text: "What?!"

dialogues.jp:
間一髪差し出した手が間に合い、美春の身体を
支える。美春は髪を乱しながら、うなだれたま
まだ。
dialogues.en:
That was a close call! I was able to hold Miharu up as she
started to collapse.
dialogues.text:
That was a close call! I was able to hold Miharu up as she
started to collapse.

dialogues.jp: まるで気を失っているように動かない。
dialogues.en: She doesn't move at all. It seems she's lost consciousness.
dialogues.text: She doesn't move at all. It seems she's lost consciousness.

dialogues.jp: 「お、おい、美春」
dialogues.en: "H-Hey, Miharu!"
dialogues.text: "H-Hey, Miharu!"

dialogues.jp:
椅子に深く座らせ、頬をぺちぺちと叩いてみる
が何の反応もない。
dialogues.en:
I sit her in the chair and gently slap her on the cheek. But
there is no reaction.
dialogues.text:
I sit her in the chair and gently slap her on the cheek. But
there is no reaction.

dialogues.jp: 「――そうか」
dialogues.en: "Okay..."
dialogues.text: "Okay..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、美春の首に掛かっているねじ巻きを外す。
dialogues.en: I take the wind-up key off from Miharu's neck.
dialogues.text: I take the wind-up key off from Miharu's neck.

dialogues.jp:
そして胸のボタンを外し、ぐいと肩の｛えり／襟｝をずら
した。
dialogues.en: And I undo the buttons on her blouse and untie her ribbon.
dialogues.text: And I undo the buttons on her blouse and untie her ribbon.

dialogues.jp: ねじを巻いてやれば、起きるはず――
dialogues.en: She should gain consciousness if I wind up her spring.
dialogues.text: She should gain consciousness if I wind up her spring.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「えっ、あ、朝倉ッ！　何やってんのッ！」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura! What the hell are you doing?!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura! What the hell are you doing?!"

dialogues.jp:
突然、扉を開けて入ってきた暦先生が、血相を
変えて駆け寄ってくる。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei rushes toward us with a totally surprised
look.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei rushes toward us with a totally surprised
look.

dialogues.jp: 「何やってんのって、美春が止まっちゃって」
dialogues.en: "What am I doing? Miharu's stopped moving."
dialogues.text: "What am I doing? Miharu's stopped moving."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「え？　あ、ああ――そうだよね。あはははは」
dialogues.en: "What? Uhh... You're right. Hahahaha..."
dialogues.text: "What? Uhh... You're right. Hahahaha..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「今、何か変なこと考えてましたか」
dialogues.en: "What were you thinking?"
dialogues.text: "What were you thinking?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そ、そんなわけないでしょう。もう。それで、
　天枷がどうなったんだって？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, nothing! What happened to Amakase?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, nothing! What happened to Amakase?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「それが――話をしていたら、突然、動かなく
　なってしまって」
dialogues.en:
"We were just talking. And all of a sudden, she just stopped
moving."
dialogues.text:
"We were just talking. And all of a sudden, she just stopped
moving."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「突然？　いくらなんでも、そんなことはない
　はずだけど」
dialogues.en: "All of a sudden? That can't be right."
dialogues.text: "All of a sudden? That can't be right."

dialogues.jp: 俺は背中に差し込んだねじ巻きをかちりと回す。
dialogues.en: I keep winding up the spring on her back.
dialogues.text: I keep winding up the spring on her back.

dialogues.jp:
美春が、びくんと反応して頭をもたげる。しば
らくするとゆっくりと目が開いた。
dialogues.en: Miharu's neck twitches, and her eyes begin to open.
dialogues.text: Miharu's neck twitches, and her eyes begin to open.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「気がついたかい？」
dialogues.en: "Are you back?"
dialogues.text: "Are you back?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あれ？　じゃないぞ。いきなり止まったから、
　慌ててしまっただろが」
dialogues.en: "You shut down, all of a sudden."
dialogues.text: "You shut down, all of a sudden."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「え、そうなんですか！　あうう、すみません。
　先輩、迷惑かけてホントにごめんなさい！」
dialogues.en: "What!? Oh, sorry. I'm very sorry!"
dialogues.text: "What!? Oh, sorry. I'm very sorry!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、そんな大げさに謝ることは、ないんだ
　けど……」
dialogues.en: "Don't be so overly apologetic."
dialogues.text: "Don't be so overly apologetic."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、あの、……それでも、ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "Yeah... but I'm so sorry."
dialogues.text: "Yeah... but I'm so sorry."

dialogues.jp:
美春は、まるで水飲み鳥みたいに何度も何度も
頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: Miharu keeps bowing to us, just like a little bird toy.
dialogues.text: Miharu keeps bowing to us, just like a little bird toy.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、それくらいにしてみんなミルクティー
　でも飲んだら？」
dialogues.en: "Let me make you guys some tea."
dialogues.text: "Let me make you guys some tea."

dialogues.jp:
先生がそう言って、俺と美春の前にコップを置
いた。甘い湯気がふわりと鼻をくすぐる。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei offers each of us a cup of tea with milk,
which tickles my nose with its sweet scent.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei offers each of us a cup of tea with milk,
which tickles my nose with its sweet scent.

dialogues.jp:
温かいミルクティーを飲み、一同がひと息つい
たところで先生が口を開いた。
dialogues.en: Sipping on her tea, Koyomi-sensei begins to talk.
dialogues.text: Sipping on her tea, Koyomi-sensei begins to talk.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「突然、停止するってのは正直異状だよ。普通
　はそうならないよう制御機能がついているか
　らね」
dialogues.en:
"Such a sudden shutdown makes no sense at all. That's not
supposed to happen."
dialogues.text:
"Such a sudden shutdown makes no sense at all. That's not
supposed to happen."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「もしかして……美春は壊れちゃったとか」
dialogues.en: "Maybe... Is Miharu broken?"
dialogues.text: "Maybe... Is Miharu broken?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いや、そういうわけじゃない。むしろ、どう
　なってるのかを調べようってことさ」
dialogues.en: "I don't think so. But we'd better check her out."
dialogues.text: "I don't think so. But we'd better check her out."

dialogues.jp:
美春は叱られている子犬のように、しゅんとなっ
ている。
dialogues.en:
Miharu looks very down, just like a little puppy chewed out
by its owner.
dialogues.text:
Miharu looks very down, just like a little puppy chewed out
by its owner.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「他に何か変わったことはなかったかい？」
dialogues.en: "Has anything else strange happened lately?"
dialogues.text: "Has anything else strange happened lately?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「俺が知ってる限りは、別に……」
dialogues.en: "Not that I know of..."
dialogues.text: "Not that I know of..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あの――あ、やっぱりいいです」
dialogues.en: "Uh... No, nothing... Really..."
dialogues.text: "Uh... No, nothing... Really..."

dialogues.jp:
美春がなぜか沈痛な面もちで何かを言いかけ、
自ら｛さえぎ／遮｝る。
dialogues.en:
Miharu was trying to say something in a mournful voice, but
something holds her back.
dialogues.text:
Miharu was trying to say something in a mournful voice, but
something holds her back.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「何かあるんなら、ちゃんと言うんだよ、天枷。
　あんた自身のことなんだから」
dialogues.en:
"You must tell me everything that bothers you, Amakase. It's
about your life."
dialogues.text:
"You must tell me everything that bothers you, Amakase. It's
about your life."

dialogues.jp: 先生がタバコを取り出し、口にくわえる。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei puts a cigarette into her mouth.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei puts a cigarette into her mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Okay..."
dialogues.text: "Okay..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「どうしたんだよ、美春。そんなに言いにくい
　ことでもあったのか？」
dialogues.en: "What's up, Miharu? Is there something wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What's up, Miharu? Is there something wrong?"

dialogues.jp:
美春は何かを言おうと何度か口を開きかけ、最
後にようやく声をしぼり出した。
dialogues.en: Miharu seems hesitant to talk about something.
dialogues.text: Miharu seems hesitant to talk about something.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「実は、最近の授業のことなんですけど、時々、
　記憶が飛ぶんです……」
dialogues.en: "It's about my memory. Sometimes it blanks out in class."
dialogues.text: "It's about my memory. Sometimes it blanks out in class."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「記憶が……飛ぶ？」
dialogues.en: "It blanks out?"
dialogues.text: "It blanks out?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「５秒とか、長くて１０秒なんですけど、気が
　つくとデータが飛んでるんです」
dialogues.en:
"It only happens for about five to ten seconds. But when I
wake up, the date is gone."
dialogues.text:
"It only happens for about five to ten seconds. But when I
wake up, the date is gone."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そんな――」
dialogues.en: "No way..."
dialogues.text: "No way..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「居眠りとは、やっぱ違いますよね。そういう
　ことはよくありますけど」
dialogues.en: "Is it anything like dozing off?"
dialogues.text: "Is it anything like dozing off?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「それとは根本的に違うよ。天枷、ちょっと、
　パソコンに繋ぐから、コード出して」
dialogues.en:
"No. It's different. Let me hook you up with the computer.
Can you give me your cable?"
dialogues.text:
"No. It's different. Let me hook you up with the computer.
Can you give me your cable?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay..."
dialogues.text: "Okay..."

dialogues.jp:
美春はうなじの髪をかき分け、何かコードの様
なモノを引っ張り出した。
dialogues.en:
Miharu pulls out some sort of cable from the nape of her
neck.
dialogues.text:
Miharu pulls out some sort of cable from the nape of her
neck.

dialogues.jp: それを先生が受け取り、パソコンに繋ぐ。
dialogues.en: And Koyomi-sensei plugs the cord into her computer.
dialogues.text: And Koyomi-sensei plugs the cord into her computer.

dialogues.jp:
カタカタとやたら早い動きでキーボードを叩く。
途端に画面に無数のウインドウが開く。
dialogues.en:
She quickly types up on the keyboard and pops something up
on the screen.
dialogues.text:
She quickly types up on the keyboard and pops something up
on the screen.

dialogues.jp:
それをじーっと見ていた先生が、なぜかため息
をついた。
dialogues.en: Staring at it, Koyomi-sensei sighs deeply.
dialogues.text: Staring at it, Koyomi-sensei sighs deeply.

dialogues.jp:
そして、メガネを押し上げ、眉間を指でぐっと
押さえる。
dialogues.en: And she lifts up her glasses and holds them with her finger.
dialogues.text: And she lifts up her glasses and holds them with her finger.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「――天枷。いつからそういう症状があったの
　かは知らないけど、どうしてもっと早く言わ
　なかったんだい？」
dialogues.en: "Amakase, you should have told me about this earlier."
dialogues.text: "Amakase, you should have told me about this earlier."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「大したことじゃないと思って……。心配をか
　けたくなかったし」
dialogues.en:
"I didn't think it was a big deal. Plus, I didn't want to
worry you."
dialogues.text:
"I didn't think it was a big deal. Plus, I didn't want to
worry you."

dialogues.jp: 美春が上目遣いで、おそるおそる呟く。
dialogues.en: Miharu casts her an upward glance.
dialogues.text: Miharu casts her an upward glance.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「頭脳のほうに随分と負担がかかってる。恐ら
　く、さっき止まったのも、前にケムリを吹い
　たのもそれが原因だと思う」
dialogues.en:
"I can see a lot of stress in your brain. This must be the
cause of the sudden shutdowns and the smoke."
dialogues.text:
"I can see a lot of stress in your brain. This must be the
cause of the sudden shutdowns and the smoke."

dialogues.jp: 今度は俺がおそるおそる｛たず／訊｝ねる。
dialogues.en: "Is that serious?"
dialogues.text: "Is that serious?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いや、まだそれほどじゃあない。けど、正直
　あまりいい状態じゃないのは間違いないよ」
dialogues.en: "It's not critical yet, but it's serious enough."
dialogues.text: "It's not critical yet, but it's serious enough."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「前も言ったけど、それほど処理能力は高くな
　いんだ。何気ないことでも、実は頭脳の負担
　になってるってことはよくあるしね」
dialogues.en:
"As I said before, you don't have a high brain capacity.
Sometimes even minor work gives your brain a great deal of
stress."
dialogues.text:
"As I said before, you don't have a high brain capacity.
Sometimes even minor work gives your brain a great deal of
stress."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「すみません……」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry..."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いや、謝ることはないよ。早く言ってくれな
　かったのは減点対象だけど」
dialogues.en: "Don't be. You just should've told me earlier. "
dialogues.text: "Don't be. You just should've told me earlier. "

dialogues.jp:
暦先生はくすりと笑いながら、美春のおでこを
コツンとついた。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-senpai chuckles and pokes Miharu on the forehead.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-senpai chuckles and pokes Miharu on the forehead.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「さて、じゃあ問題は何がそんなに負担をかけ
　ているかってことなんだけど、最近、何か変
　わったことをしてる？」
dialogues.en:
"We need to figure out what caused the stress. Have you been
doing anything particular lately?"
dialogues.text:
"We need to figure out what caused the stress. Have you been
doing anything particular lately?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「変わったこと……負担をかけそうなこと……」
dialogues.en: "Anything particular? Causing the stress..."
dialogues.text: "Anything particular? Causing the stress..."

dialogues.jp:
俺はここ数日を思い返してみる。が、いまいち
それに該当しそうな記憶はない。
dialogues.en:
I was trying to trace back the last couple of days in my
head, but I couldn't think of anything.
dialogues.text:
I was trying to trace back the last couple of days in my
head, but I couldn't think of anything.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あれですかね。１日のバナナ消費量が、だん
　だん増えていってることとか」
dialogues.en: "I eat bananas every day..."
dialogues.text: "I eat bananas every day..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「――それは頭脳への負担じゃないだろ。て言
　うか、ほどほどにしなさい」
dialogues.en:
"That's got nothing to do with your brain functions. Oh, by
the way, you eat them too much."
dialogues.text:
"That's got nothing to do with your brain functions. Oh, by
the way, you eat them too much."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「別に頭脳に負担をかけるようなことはしてま
　せんよ。宿題なんて、むしろ全部はやってま
　せんし」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not doing anything stressful to my brain. I'm not even
doing all my homework."
dialogues.text:
"I'm not doing anything stressful to my brain. I'm not even
doing all my homework."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「――それは、全部やりなさい」
dialogues.en: "Do your homework."
dialogues.text: "Do your homework."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「読む本も、最近はマンガばっかりで。ちゃん
　とした本はどうも苦手だし」
dialogues.en: "I'm reading only manga, because I don't like other books."
dialogues.text: "I'm reading only manga, because I don't like other books."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「――もっと、本は読みなさい」
dialogues.en: "Read more other books."
dialogues.text: "Read more other books."

dialogues.jp:
すっかり呆れ気味の先生は、くわえっぱなしだっ
たタバコにようやく火をつけた。
dialogues.en:
Very amused by Miharu's responses, Koyomi-sensei finally
lights up her cigarette.
dialogues.text:
Very amused by Miharu's responses, Koyomi-sensei finally
lights up her cigarette.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、最近放課後は何してる？」
dialogues.en: "What have you been doing after school lately, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "What have you been doing after school lately, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「何してるって、別にこれと言って……。せい
　ぜい思い出探しくらいで」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing special. We've been going around town to get some
of her memories back."
dialogues.text:
"Nothing special. We've been going around town to get some
of her memories back."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……思い出探し？」
dialogues.en: "Get her memories back?"
dialogues.text: "Get her memories back?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「はい。頭脳への負担になるようなことじゃな
　いと思いますけど。最近の悩みの一つでは、
　ありますが」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, but it's not stressful for my brain, although I'm
struggling a bit with it."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, but it's not stressful for my brain, although I'm
struggling a bit with it."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なんだい、その思い出探しってのは」
dialogues.en: "What are you guys doing?"
dialogues.text: "What are you guys doing?"

dialogues.jp:
暦先生がタバコを灰皿に置き、｛いぶか／訝｝しげな表情で
身を乗り出してくる。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei puts her cigarette on the ashtray and bends
forward with a suspicious look.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei puts her cigarette on the ashtray and bends
forward with a suspicious look.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あのですね、みんなが美春のことを『美春さ
　ん』だと思ってくれている以上、美春は出来
　る限りそうでありたいと思ってる訳ですよ」
dialogues.en:
"People see me as 'Miharu-san'. So I just want to be as much
like her as possible."
dialogues.text:
"People see me as 'Miharu-san'. So I just want to be as much
like her as possible."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "And?"
dialogues.text: "And?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そのために、『美春さん』にあって美春にな
　いモノは何かと考えた時、それは｛・・・／思い出｝だっ
　て気づいたわけですよ」
dialogues.en:
"I figured that the only thing 'Miharu-san' has that I don't
have is her memories."
dialogues.text:
"I figured that the only thing 'Miharu-san' has that I don't
have is her memories."

dialogues.jp:
なぜか、暦先生の顔がだんだん険しくなってい
くように見える。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei looks pretty grim.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei looks pretty grim.

dialogues.jp:
灰が落ちそうになるまでタバコを一気に吸い、
灰皿に押しつける。
dialogues.en: She inhales deeply and puts out her cigarette.
dialogues.text: She inhales deeply and puts out her cigarette.

dialogues.jp:
そしてすぐに新しいタバコを取り出し、また火
をつけた。
dialogues.en: Then she lights another cigarette again.
dialogues.text: Then she lights another cigarette again.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「だから、美春は今、朝倉先輩と一緒に『美春
　さん』の思い出を求めて、いろんなトコロを
　回っているわけなんです」
dialogues.en:
"So Asakura-sempai and I have been going around the town to
look for Miharu-san's memories in me."
dialogues.text:
"So Asakura-sempai and I have been going around the town to
look for Miharu-san's memories in me."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「思い出を求めてって……どうやって求めるん
　だよ」
dialogues.en: "Looking for Amakase's memories in you...? How?"
dialogues.text: "Looking for Amakase's memories in you...? How?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「だから、美春の中に眠っている思い出を、思
　い出せれば――、」
dialogues.en:
"If I can bring back the memories that are dormant in my
mind, perhaps..."
dialogues.text:
"If I can bring back the memories that are dormant in my
mind, perhaps..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「記憶のデータはないって断言したはずだけど」
dialogues.en: "I told you that you don't have any memory data."
dialogues.text: "I told you that you don't have any memory data."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ありますよ。だって美春は夢を見ましたもん」
dialogues.en: "I do, because I had a dream!"
dialogues.text: "I do, because I had a dream!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いくら天枷がそう言い張っても、存在しない
　ものは存在しないんだよ」
dialogues.en: "No, you don't. Absolutely no."
dialogues.text: "No, you don't. Absolutely no."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そんなことないです！　だってあの時の夢は、
　本当に――」
dialogues.en: "That's not true! That dream was real..."
dialogues.text: "That's not true! That dream was real..."

dialogues.jp:
本当に、昔の夢だった。いつのことか、どんな
出来事かはわからない。
dialogues.en:
Yes, that dream was something about our past. But I don't
know anything more.
dialogues.text:
Yes, that dream was something about our past. But I don't
know anything more.

dialogues.jp:
けど、子供の頃に、音夢と美春と、俺とが遊ん
でいたことは事実だ。
dialogues.en:
However, it's true that Nemu, Miharu and I were playing
together as kids.
dialogues.text:
However, it's true that Nemu, Miharu and I were playing
together as kids.

dialogues.jp:
俺や音夢だけじゃなく、そんなことは杉並だっ
て知っていることだ。
dialogues.en: Even Suginami knows this as a fact.
dialogues.text: Even Suginami knows this as a fact.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いいかい？　物事を思い出すという行為は、
　人間にとってはごく自然の行為だけど、実は
　相当複雑なメカニズムで動いているんだ」
dialogues.en:
"The act of remembering might sound simple -- it's something
we do every day. But its inner workings actually involve a
complex mechanism."
dialogues.text:
"The act of remembering might sound simple -- it's something
we do every day. But its inner workings actually involve a
complex mechanism."

dialogues.jp:
先生は、美春をなだめるような落ち着いた口調
で、ゆっくりと語りだした。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei speaks gently to calm Miharu down.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei speaks gently to calm Miharu down.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「存在しない記憶を呼び出そうとすれば、どう
　なるかわかるかい？」
dialogues.en:
"Do you know what happens if you try to bring back memories
that don't exist in you?"
dialogues.text:
"Do you know what happens if you try to bring back memories
that don't exist in you?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「思考上はそれほど大したことには思えないか
　もしれないけれど、実際は頭脳に矛盾した行
　為を強要してることになる」
dialogues.en:
"You may not think it's a big thing for a brain. But, in
reality, what you're doing is forcing your brain to work
against its functions, and it creates a lot of conflicts and
inconsistencies in the inner workings of brain."
dialogues.text:
"You may not think it's a big thing for a brain. But, in
reality, what you're doing is forcing your brain to work
against its functions, and it creates a lot of conflicts and
inconsistencies in the inner workings of brain."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、本人が気づかないうちに、その負担
　がどんどん蓄積していくってことですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Does that mean she's unconsciously making a lot of stress
in her mind?"
dialogues.text:
"Does that mean she's unconsciously making a lot of stress
in her mind?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そういうことになるね。今はまだフリーズす
　るだけで、再起動すれば済むけど、今後はど
　うなるかわからない」
dialogues.en:
"That's right. For a while you just freeze, then you move
again after you get rebooted. But if the problem continues,
I can't predict..."
dialogues.text:
"That's right. For a while you just freeze, then you move
again after you get rebooted. But if the problem continues,
I can't predict..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そんな！」
dialogues.en: "What?!"
dialogues.text: "What?!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ぶっちゃけて言ってしまうと、開発に携わっ
　ているあたしだって、もちろん天枷教授だっ
　て、どうなるかなんて予測はつかないんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Honestly, even Dr. Amakase and I have no idea of what is
going to happen."
dialogues.text:
"Honestly, even Dr. Amakase and I have no idea of what is
going to happen."

dialogues.jp:
美春は試作品だ。これだけ人間らしく精巧に動
くロボットは世界でも類を見ない。
dialogues.en:
Miharu is still a pilot product. No other human-like robot
has ever been made in the world.
dialogues.text:
Miharu is still a pilot product. No other human-like robot
has ever been made in the world.

dialogues.jp:
だが、精密であるがゆえに、その人工頭脳が、
どんな反応を示し、何が起こるかわからない。
そういうことなのだろう。
dialogues.en: Anything could happen to such a precise, artificial brain.
dialogues.text: Anything could happen to such a precise, artificial brain.

dialogues.jp:
むしろ、それを知るための美春という存在なの
だから。
dialogues.en: Ironically, Miharu exists for us to find out.
dialogues.text: Ironically, Miharu exists for us to find out.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ここで楽観的な考えはあまりしたくない」
dialogues.en:
"I don't want to be optimistic, so let me be straight. If
you really want to take care of yourself, stop looking for
your memories."
dialogues.text:
"I don't want to be optimistic, so let me be straight. If
you really want to take care of yourself, stop looking for
your memories."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「――でも、美春は」
dialogues.en: "But... I want..."
dialogues.text: "But... I want..."

dialogues.jp: 美春が立ち上がり身を乗り出す。
dialogues.en: Miharu stands up and leans forward a bit.
dialogues.text: Miharu stands up and leans forward a bit.

dialogues.jp:
暦先生もゆっくりと立ち上がり、美春の両肩に
そっと手を添える。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei stands up slowly and puts her hands on her
shoulders.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei stands up slowly and puts her hands on her
shoulders.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あたしは、天枷に苦しい思いをしてほしくな
　いんだ。だから、わかってほしい」
dialogues.en: "I don't want you to suffer any more, Miharu."
dialogues.text: "I don't want you to suffer any more, Miharu."

dialogues.jp:
まるで、自分の娘を見る母親のような目で語り
かける。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei talks to her gently as if she were her mother.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei talks to her gently as if she were her mother.

dialogues.jp:
美春は何かを言おうとしたが、それを飲み込み、
椅子に座った。
dialogues.en: Miharu holds back her words and sits down.
dialogues.text: Miharu holds back her words and sits down.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう、天枷」
dialogues.en: "Thanks, Amakase."
dialogues.text: "Thanks, Amakase."

dialogues.jp: 先生がにっこりと笑い、腰を降ろす。
dialogues.en: With a smile, Koyomi-sensei sits in her chair.
dialogues.text: With a smile, Koyomi-sensei sits in her chair.

dialogues.jp: 灰皿のタバコはすっかり灰になって消えていた。
dialogues.en: Her cigarette on the ashtray disappears into ashes.
dialogues.text: Her cigarette on the ashtray disappears into ashes.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、朝倉。後は頼んだよ」
dialogues.en: "You take care of her, Asakura. Okay?"
dialogues.text: "You take care of her, Asakura. Okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「天枷も、あまり落ち込んでないで元気だしな」
dialogues.en: "Don't be so discouraged. Hang in there, Amakase."
dialogues.text: "Don't be so discouraged. Hang in there, Amakase."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、元気ないなぁ。ほら、これをやるから」
dialogues.en: "Pull yourself together, Amakase. Take this."
dialogues.text: "Pull yourself together, Amakase. Take this."

dialogues.jp:
と言って、懐から取り出したのはバナナチップ
だった。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei pulls a bag of banana chips out of her pocket.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei pulls a bag of banana chips out of her pocket.

dialogues.jp: 「そんなもの、どこから取り出したんですか」
dialogues.en: "Where did that come from?"
dialogues.text: "Where did that come from?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ハハハ、あたしの白衣には、四次元ポッケが
　あるから」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha. I've got magic pockets."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha. I've got magic pockets."

dialogues.jp:
美春はバナナチップの袋を受け取ると、さっそ
く開けて口へ運んだ。
dialogues.en: Miharu quickly opens up the bag and takes some chips.
dialogues.text: Miharu quickly opens up the bag and takes some chips.

dialogues.jp: ――ポリポリ
dialogues.en: Crunch, crunch.
dialogues.text: Crunch, crunch.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、おいしい」
dialogues.en: "Th-This tastes good."
dialogues.text: "Th-This tastes good."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そうだろ？　保存料、着色料、甘味料無添加
　のヤツだからね」
dialogues.en: "See? No added preservatives. Pretty healthy stuff."
dialogues.text: "See? No added preservatives. Pretty healthy stuff."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「こんなバナナもあるなんて」
dialogues.en: "I've never tasted bananas like this."
dialogues.text: "I've never tasted bananas like this."

dialogues.jp: ――ポリポリ、ポリポリ
dialogues.en: Crunch, crunch.
dialogues.text: Crunch, crunch.

dialogues.jp:
美春は、やけに嬉しそうな顔で、バナナチップ
を食べていた。
dialogues.en: Miharu keeps eating banana chips with a big smile.
dialogues.text: Miharu keeps eating banana chips with a big smile.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「天枷はそうやって、笑ってるほうがいいね」
dialogues.en: "You deserve to smile more like that."
dialogues.text: "You deserve to smile more like that."

dialogues.jp:
先生はそう言って笑ったけど、どことなくカラ
元気に見えてしまった。
dialogues.en: But I can see that Miharu's smile is rather exaggerated.
dialogues.text: But I can see that Miharu's smile is rather exaggerated.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあね」
dialogues.en: "See you later, guys."
dialogues.text: "See you later, guys."

dialogues.jp: 軽く手を振って、準備室に戻る先生。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei waves at us and goes back to the biology room.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei waves at us and goes back to the biology room.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、美春。帰ろうか」
dialogues.en: "Let's go home, Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Let's go home, Miharu."

dialogues.jp:
と、振り返ると、バナナチップの袋をぎゅうっ
と握りしめる美春がいた。
dialogues.en: Miharu holds the bag of banana chips tight.
dialogues.text: Miharu holds the bag of banana chips tight.

dialogues.jp:
途端に落ち込んだ姿で、さっきまでは多分、暦
先生のために取り繕っていたのだろう。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly Miharu looks very disappointed. I guess she was
pretending to be fine before Koyomi-sensei.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly Miharu looks very disappointed. I guess she was
pretending to be fine before Koyomi-sensei.

dialogues.jp:
「ほらほら、元気出せよ。な？　先生は理論上、
　もしかしたらの話をしてるだけなんだから」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry, Miharu. What Koyomi-sensei was talking about
was only a possibility."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry, Miharu. What Koyomi-sensei was talking about
was only a possibility."

dialogues.jp:
なんて、中途半端な言葉しかかけてやれない自
分が情けなかった。
dialogues.en: This is all I can say. I wish I could cheer her up more.
dialogues.text: This is all I can say. I wish I could cheer her up more.

dialogues.jp: ◆美春の不調◆
dialogues.en: ◆Something seems to be bothering Miharu.◆
dialogues.text: ◆Something seems to be bothering Miharu.◆

dialogues.jp:
話をしている最中、美春が突然停止してしまっ
た。調べてみた結果、頭脳に相当な負担がかかっ
ていたらしい。
dialogues.en: "I thought it would be easy to get my memories back."
dialogues.text: "I thought it would be easy to get my memories back."

dialogues.jp:
そして、その原因が思い出探しにあると暦先生
は言った。今後、思い出探しを続ければ、美春
の頭脳がどうなるかわからないとも。
dialogues.en: Sitting in a chair, Miharu sighs deeply.
dialogues.text: Sitting in a chair, Miharu sighs deeply.

dialogues.jp:
落ち込む美春に対し、中途半端な言葉しかかけ
てやれない自分が情けなかった。
dialogues.en:
"I'm sure lots of things happened to Miharu, even just in
the Art or English Classrooms."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sure lots of things happened to Miharu, even just in
the Art or English Classrooms."
